sink_embedding_table.description: Writes each tile's `features` and position as a row of an embedding table.

output.description: The output name callers and exposure refer to.
output.title: Output

sink_embedding_table.title: embedding_table (sink)

sink_score_grid.description: Averages each tile's `scores` over the cells the tile covers into a score grid.

output.description: The output name callers and exposure refer to.
output.title: Output

sink_score_grid.title: score_grid (sink)

source_slide_tiles.description: Grid tiles of one slide level, without background or tiles outside the ROI.

tile_size.description: Tile edge in pixels; the first model step's when left out.
tile_size.title: Tile Size

mpp.description: Microns per pixel to read at (the closest slide level); the first model step's when left out.
mpp.title: Mpp

region_of_interest.description: Whether a run must give a region-of-interest mask (`required`), may (`optional`) or may not (`ignored`); only tiles the mask covers are read.
region_of_interest.title: Region Of Interest

stride_fraction.description: How far apart tiles are, as a share of the tile size: above 0, up to 1. 1 places tiles side by side; 0.5 overlaps them by half, for a finer result that takes about four times as long.
stride_fraction.title: Stride Fraction

skip_background.description: Whether tiles without tissue are skipped; they get no result. Skipping is faster and leaves empty glass out. On by default.
skip_background.title: Skip Background

min_tissue_fraction.description: How much of a tile must be tissue for it to be analysed, when background is skipped: from 0 up to but not including 1. 0 analyses every tile with any tissue; 0.5 needs at least half.
min_tissue_fraction.title: Min Tissue Fraction

source_slide_tiles.title: slide_tiles (source)

step_center_crop.description: Keeps the centre square of each uint8 tile, as torchvision's `CenterCrop`.

size.description: The edge of the centre square kept, in pixels.
size.title: Size

step_center_crop.title: center_crop (step)

step_cls_mean_pool.description: Pools a ViT's tokens into two vectors: the class token and the patch mean.

registers.description: Register tokens after the class token, left out of the mean and of unpooled tokens (Virchow2 has 4).
registers.title: Registers

step_cls_mean_pool.title: cls_mean_pool (step)

step_normalize.description: Turns uint8 RGB tiles into the float32 input most PyTorch models expect.

preset.description: Named mean and std: `imagenet` is mean (0.485, 0.456, 0.406), std (0.229, 0.224, 0.225). Give either this or `mean` and `std`.
preset.title: Preset

std.description: Per-channel (RGB) standard deviation, on the [0, 1] scale.

step_normalize.title: normalize (step)

step_resize.description: Resizes uint8 RGB tiles, as torchvision's `Resize` does to a PIL image.

size.description: The shorter edge after resizing, in pixels; the longer edge keeps the aspect ratio, so a square tile becomes `size` x `size`.
size.title: Size

step_resize.title: resize (step)
